value.rationale: The result identifies a natural critical-scale failure of ordinary Gaussian weak convergence under arbitrarily small periodic memory perturbations, proves the entire phase-indexed log-time covariance structure, and provides an exact recovery formula linking the observed Gaussian covariance clock to the original memory forcing. This process-level statement is not a routine scalar CLT or a finite numerical exercise.
